'''Benjamin''' (Japanese: '''ボクゼン''' ''Bokuzen'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP144|Gone With the Windworks!]]''. 

Benjamin is an elderly security guard who works at the [[Valley Windworks]]. He tends to sleep in the camera control room while his fleet of {{p|Magnemite}} survey the complex.

While {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were looking for [[Lyra's Marill]], they found themselves trapped in the Valley Windworks' basement. Benjamin remained dormant throughout the whole ordeal, forcing the group to escape through the air-duct system. He woke up in time to wish Ash and his friends well on their journey before falling back asleep.

==Trivia==
* Benjamin is the second character of the day with ties to the Valley Windworks whose dub name was only revealed via {{wp|closed captioning}}. The other is [[Karsten]] from ''[[DP028|Drifloon On the Wind!]]''.
** Coincidentally, they both have Electric types as their only known Pokémon.
